outcome_blind_declaration.note: Definitions only; no scored artifact exists or may be created here. This control is NOT expected to perform well; declaring its expected failure direction is mechanism falsification, not an outcome computation.

mechanism_under_test: TIME_SERIES_TREND_SELECTION. The family's causal claim is that buying ETFs whose own trailing trend is UP (and de-risking by realized vol) beats the flat benchmark because the trend sign carries forward-looking information. This control destroys that mechanism while holding every other lever constant.

control_mutation.mutation: Eligibility sign INVERTED: ETF i is ELIGIBLE at decision t iff m_i(t) < 0 (12-month TR-chain return NEGATIVE). The anchor buys trend-UP ETFs; this control buys trend-DOWN ETFs.
control_mutation.everything_else: IDENTICAL to the anchor: same 11-ETF cohort, same 252-session lookback and zero threshold, same 63-session realized-vol estimator, same 10% vol target and g(t) mapping, same 35% cap and equal weighting with cash residual, same monthly clock, same costs (10 bps/side), same one-event delay, same ramp-in, folds, purge, force-flat terminal rule, same evidence minimums and concentration limits.
control_mutation.why_this_mutation: Inverting the sign inverts the information direction of the primary feature while preserving the portfolio-construction machinery, so any scored difference isolates the trend-selection lever. The vol lever is deliberately held constant so the control tests the FAMILY's primary mechanism (trend sign), not the secondary one (vol mapping); per PLAN section 10 exactly one control is registered this cycle.

cohort_usage.justification: Identical to anchor. The control must see the same opportunity set or it would not isolate the mutation.

data_semantics.signal_series: TR chain per amended FD2 formula (split_factors.json amended_fd2_formula): raw closes x issuer-confirmed split factors (XLK/XLE/XLY/XLU/XLB factor 2.0 eff 2025-12-05) + official issuer (SSGA/SPDR) distribution records.
data_semantics.fill_series: RAW executable closes, next regular session, one-event delay mandatory.
data_semantics.split_handling: Identical to anchor; factor-adjusted TR chain; notional-based targets.

feature_definition.eligibility_rule: ELIGIBLE iff m_i(t) < 0 (INVERTED relative to anchor's m_i(t) > 0)
feature_definition.not_a_grid: Single frozen inverted configuration; no grid.

volatility_estimator.formula: identical to anchor: sigma_arena(t) = sqrt( mean over ELIGIBLE i of sigma_i(t)^2 )

defensive_allocation_mapping.gross_scalar: g(t) = min(1.0, 0.10 / sigma_arena(t)); g = 1.0 if sigma_arena <= 0
defensive_allocation_mapping.base_weights: w_i(t) = min(0.35, 1/|E|) over the INVERTED eligible set; residual to CASH
defensive_allocation_mapping.final_weights: ETF weight = g(t) * w_i(t); CASH weight = 1 - g(t) * sum_i w_i(t)

edge_cases.eligible_set_empty: possible by construction iff all 11 ETFs have m >= 0 (broad uptrend); book = 100% cash
edge_cases.gross_invariant: gross <= 1.0 always; single-ETF weight <= 0.35 always; long-only; no shorting; no leverage

decision_clock.rule: Identical to anchor: last completed regular session of each calendar month; fill next regular session, raw close, one-event delay.

warmup_ramp_in.rule: Identical to anchor: decisions allowed only once every cohort member has >= 252 completed TR sessions from 2018-01-02; 100% cash before.

partition_handling.terminal_rule: Identical to anchor: force-flat at each fold's scored_end close; no executions in purge.

benchmark.context_benchmark: SPY TR chain (amended architecture), diagnostic only.
benchmark.fairness: Identical machinery and costs to anchor; only the sign differs.

turnover_expectation.expected_two_way_annual: 2.0x - 4.0x (same structural range as anchor; inverted states share the same persistence). Preregistered expectation, not computed.

capacity_reasoning.scope: Identical to anchor: personal research-scale book; no capacity claim beyond research scale.

minimum_evidence_count.note: Same as anchor. NOTE: the inverted eligible set is empty whenever all 11 ETFs are in uptrend simultaneously; such months are valid 100%-cash decision events and COUNT toward evidence.

expected_sign_and_falsification.expected_direction_predeclared: Materially BELOW the anchor on fold-level risk-adjusted evidence vs the flat benchmark, and expected near or below zero. This expected failure is the point of the control.
expected_sign_and_falsification.falsifying_result: If the control's fold-level risk-adjusted evidence (Z8 frozen scorer primary statistic: excess vs flat 0% benchmark, realized-vol-normalized, per S0 fold) is >= the anchor's in >= 2 of 3 folds, the time-series trend-selection mechanism is FALSIFIED for this family: all positive family claims are void, the family's verdict becomes mechanism-falsified, and the family's slots stay unused (no reassignment this cycle).
expected_sign_and_falsification.secondary_void_condition: If the control fails its own evidence minimums or invariant tests (leverage/cap/lookahead), the control is void as a causal test and the family's mechanism claim is UNTESTED (treated as not established, not as supported).
expected_sign_and_falsification.implementation_fixtures: Control-destruction fixture REQUIRED (PLAN section 11): sign flip must change the eligible set on hand-computed vectors; expected-failure direction fixture; no-lookahead fixture; terminal-close golden.

no_tuning_declaration: The control is a pure sign mutation of the anchor with zero free parameters. No parameter was selected by comparing candidate outcomes. No grid exists. No revision after freeze. S1 never read.

literature.cite: Moskowitz, Ooi, Pedersen (2012), 'Time Series Momentum', Journal of Financial Economics 104(2)
literature.use: sign convention whose inversion this control tests
